pass_condition: Over reviewer-authored fixtures, last_non_bot_commit_at: reuses commit_domains.is_bot (same object as the landed cvi.collect.commits.is_bot), returns the max over non-bot dated commits, serialises ISO UTC with a trailing Z, gives one identical string for three spellings of one instant, returns value=None with a measured-absence method plus source/source_hash/fetched_at when no non-bot commit exists, and Unmeasured(collector_failure) when the envelope is missing, malformed or carries no fetched_at; a commit with no login and a non-noreply email counts as human and that rule is documented in the function's own docstring.

observations: A 365 d envelope that exists but records no fetched_at is treated as absent and silently falls back to commits_180d; the data-shape check correctly does not fall back.
Mutants A2 (max->min) and A5a/A5b (absence/failure swapped) were re-executed by the reviewer and killed 9 and 1/3 tests respectively.

not_checked.statement: A commits_365d envelope does not exist anywhere in the sample-200 corpus, so the non-fallback (365 d) production path is exercised only by reviewer-authored fixtures, never against real collected data.
Leap-second and pre-1970 dates were not exercised; datetime.fromisoformat's own parsing was taken as correct.

counter_check.text: Re-derive the fact for all 50 fixture repos from the raw corpus with an implementation written from the design (D-TIE-1 item 7, D-IN-1) that imports no cvi module, reading the bot table out of the BASE commit's collector source text; compare value, method and fetched_at per repo.
